description:
Detects insecure deserialization of Java, Python, PHP, and .NET serialized objects

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg07_010", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%insecure%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%deserialization%') AND "value" > 0
